11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child is terribly, monumentally bored and has told every adult in the village at least twice.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is bored. Terribly bored. Monumentally bored. (subject.He/She) has informed every adult in the village of this fact at least twice. (friend) is beginning to suspect that boredom may be the only subject (subject) intends to discuss today.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) considers gathering shells, drawing pictures, climbing a tree, and making a toy boat. None sounds interesting. Then (subject.he/she) notices two ants carrying an enormous crumb. For the next hour (subject) follows them with intense scientific curiosity.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Alright," says (friend). "You can be bored." (subject) stares in disbelief. After a while (subject.he/she) begins drawing patterns in the sand with a stick. Soon the patterns become roads, then houses, then an entire imaginary village. (subject) forgets to complain.
